opis: Kadr powoli zbliża się do Twojej twarzy.

przepis.opis_efektu: A slow, continuous zoom-in on the talking head throughout the clip. Start at scale 1.0 and end at scale 1.12–1.15 by the clip's last frame. Movement is perfectly linear, imperceptible moment to moment but visible when comparing first and last frame. The zoom centers on the face — keep the eyes in the upper third of the frame at all times. Do not zoom past 1.2 (face should never fill more than 80% of frame width). Apply as a single smooth animation across the entire clip duration, not in steps.
